title: Transformation using Electroporation
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7jzhkp6

steps.title: Prepare cells and cuvette
steps.instruction: Prepare the electrocompetent cells and the electroporation cuvette for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Pre-chill the electroporation cuvette on ice.
Thaw the electrocompetent cells on ice.
Mix the cells by flicking gently.

steps.title: Combine cells and DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the required amount of cells and DNA into the cuvette.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the amount of cells required for the specific electroporation cuvette (e.g., 50µL).

steps.title: Perform electroporation
steps.instruction: Apply the electrical pulse to the cell mixture using a pulse generator.

substeps.instruction: Insert the correct specifications (Voltage, Resistance, etc.) for the used transformation strain into the pulse generator.
Place the electroporation cuvette and apply the pulse.

steps.title: Recover cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells in SOC medium to allow for recovery.

substeps.instruction: Immediately add SOC medium to bring the total volume to 1mL (e.g., 950µL).
Incubate the culture for 1 hour at 37ºC.

steps.title: Concentrate the culture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture to resuspend the cells in a smaller volume.

substeps.instruction: Spin the culture down at 3000rpm for 3 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in the remaining 100 µL.

steps.title: Plate and incubate
steps.instruction: Spread the cells onto agar plates and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Plate the cells on agar plates containing the appropriate antibiotic, if applicable.
